verdict.rationale: The evidence pack lacks any explicit documentation of an embed.js-style snippet supporting inline, popup, and floating widget modes. It only mentions React 'atoms' for building custom scheduling UI in an app (cal-com-docs-10, cal-com-docs-36, cal-com-docs-54), which is a different integration method (framework components, not a drop-in snippet) and requires managed users rather than a simple embed code. Missing for 10: documented embed.js snippet, inline/popup/floating-button embed modes, and any non-React (plain HTML/JS) usage example.
